episodes.description: Can a small group change a local council decision? When Julie learns her community library may close, she joins other residents in a campaign to save it. episodes.title: Travelling safely in rural and remote Australia - Baadiyaa fi lafa fagoo Australia keessa nageenyaan imaluu - Australia Explained
episodes.description: Australia is a vast and diverse country to explore, but driving in rural and remote areas can involve conditions you may not encounter in cities. Knowing what to expect and how to prepare can help you travel more safely and confidently. - Biyya Australia guddoo fi aada daneettii biyyaa isin ilaaluu qabdani dha garuu gara baadiyaa fi naannawa fagoo yeroo ooftan haallan magaalaa keessatti hin agarre isin mudachuu danda’a. Daandii gara baadiyaa geessu irra yeroo deemtan maaltu isin mudachuu akka malu beekuu fi dursitanii of qopheessuun nageenyaa fi of irratti-amantummaan geessanii deebi’uuf isin gargaara.

episodes.title: How can my child learn about Indigenous Australia? - Ijoolleen koo waa'ee Abbootii Dachee Australia akkamiin barachuu danda'u - AE
episodes.description: Supporting your child’s connection with the world’s oldest continuing living culture is one of the greatest gifts you can offer them while raising them in Australia. But if you’re new to the country, you may be unsure where to begin. Here are some starting points and ideas to help you and your child learn about Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, cultures and history. - Walitti dhufeenya ijoolleen keessan aadaa addunyaa irratti turaa tahe akkasumas jiraataa fi itti fufiinsa qabu deeggaruun ijoollee keessan Australia keessatti guddachaa jiraniif kennaawwan gurugddaa kennuufii dandeessan keessaa isa tokko dha. Garuu yoo biyyattiif haaraa taatan eessaa akka eegaltan beekuu dhiisuu maltu. Ijoolleen keessan waa'ee aadaa fi seenaa ummattoota Abbootii Dachee fi Torres Strait Islander akka baraniif qabxiiilee fi yaaddan isin gargaaruu danda'an tokko tokko kunoo ti.

episodes.title: Can you pick fruit from someone's garden? - Ooyiruu namaa keessaa fuduraa fi kuduraa cirachuu dandeessuu? - Australia Explained
episodes.description: Walking through an Australian suburb, you might spot everything from curry leaves and lemons to tomatoes and herbs growing in front gardens or on verges. But is it legal to pick it? This guide explains when it's legal to pick produce, why permission matters, and how community gardens offer another way to grow your own food. - Naannawa Australia keessa yeroo deemtan tarii biqiltoowwan kanneen akka baala urgooftuu fi loomil irraa haga timaatimatti manneen namaa fuulduratti biqilanii ykn qarqara karaatti biqilanii arguu maltu. Garu cirachuun seeraan ehamamaa dhaa? Qophiin kun yeroo itti oomisha akkasii fayyadamuun ehamamuu fi ehamnis maaliif barbaachisaa akka tahe akkasumas qonnaan hawaasaa karaa biraa isin ittiin fayyadamtanii oomisha barbaaddan itti qotatachuu dandeessan tahuu ibsa.
